title: Mapped fill row
description: One line of fills.mapped.jsonl.gz. id is the sha256 hex of the mapped venue, pair, order, ts, price, qty and side, so the same fill pulled in two windows carries the same id; venue and pair are the market maker's own strings; order references an id on the same venue and pair in the same window's orders.mapped; prices and quantities are decimal strings; ts is UTC epoch milliseconds.
